coded.vl: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
coded.n: Domestic workers are outside the Labour Law but covered by a dedicated regulation with fines (OMR 50-500 per violation, multiplied by the number of workers); it repeals MR 189/2004.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required, no language rule
coded.n: Written contract in Arabic, registered online with the ministry.
The minimum wage does not apply to migrant workers.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: Paid in Omani rials within seven days of the due date, proved by a signed register or a local bank account; the ministry may set a payment system; deductions capped at 25 per cent.

coded.vl: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
coded.n: Up to 12 hours a day with at least 8 hours' rest; up to 2 hours' paid overtime by written agreement. Longer than the 8-hour norm for other workers.

coded.vl: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
coded.n: At least one paid rest day a week; work on that day only with written consent and extra pay or a substitute day.

coded.vl: Equal to or longer than for other workers
coded.n: At least 21 days' paid annual leave; untaken leave paid out at the end of service.

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
coded.n: The employer may not keep the passport or documents except with the worker's written consent.

coded.vl: Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
coded.n: Food and suitable housing: a ventilated, lit and air-conditioned room with a bed, wardrobe and proper toilet; free transport for workers living out.

coded.vl: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: No unilateral right to change employer: transfer by agreement only. The worker may leave without notice, keeping all rights, if wages are unpaid for over two months or in cases of fraud, assault or serious danger.

coded.vl: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
coded.n: The employer may not take any money from the worker for recruitment, employment or transfer; agency fees are barred by the 2011 agency rules.
Licensed recruitment offices; the office may notify the ministry on the worker's behalf.
Ministry inspectors may interview the worker and request documents; a home visit needs the Public Prosecution's permission.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
coded.n: Labour Law dispute procedure applies; the worker pays no court fees at any stage.
coded.src: MD 574/2025 Reg. art. 37; Royal Decree 53/2023 art. 9

coded.vl: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
coded.n: Up to 30 days' paid sick leave a year; health insurance; end-of-service pay of half a month's wage a year after two years' service (counted from the regulation's entry into force); maternity not provided.

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only
coded.n: Forced labour and violence banned; degrading advertising of workers banned; the worker may leave after assault.
The regulation has no provision on association; Labour Law union rights do not extend to domestic workers.
